class.name: NLightDriverBoard
class.description: Object to control the nLight Driver board attached to a card.

method.name: InitializeLaser
method.description: Initializes the NLight laser via the driver board.

param.name: EnableAutomaticLaserModeSwitching
param.description: If true, laser modes will be used from the corresponding build file.

method.name: DisableLaser
method.description: Disables the NLight laser via the driver board.

method.name: AutomaticLaserModeSwitchingIsEnabled
method.description: Returns if the automatic laser mode switching is enabled.

param.name: EnableAutomaticLaserModeSwitching
param.description: If true, laser modes will be used from the corresponding build file.

method.name: EnableAutomaticLaserModeSwitching
method.description: Enables the Automatic laser mode switching.

method.name: DisableAutomaticLaserModeSwitching
method.description: Disables the Automatic laser mode switching.

method.name: SetLaserModeMaxPowerOverride
method.description: Sets an override for the maximum available laser power used for a specific laser mode. Can not be changed for laser mode 0.

param.name: LaserMode
param.description: The laser mode that shall be changed. MUST be between 1 and 7.

param.name: MaxPowerInWatts
param.description: Maximum laser power in Watts. MUST be larger than 1.0.

method.name: GetLaserModeMaxPowerOverride
method.description: Gets an override for the maximum available laser power used for a specific laser mode. Returns default max laser power for laser mode 0 or if no laser mode override has been set.

param.name: LaserMode
param.description: The laser mode that shall be queried. MUST be between 0 and 7.

param.name: MaxPowerInWatts
param.description: Maximum laser power in Watts for this Laser Mode.

method.name: ClearLaserModeMaxPowerOverride
method.description: Clears a power override for a specific laser mode.

param.name: LaserMode
param.description: The laser mode that shall be changed. MUST be between 1 and 7.

method.name: ClearAllLaserModeMaxPowerOverrides
method.description: Clears all max power overrides for the different laser modes.

method.name: ClearError
method.description: Clears any error state in the NLight laser via the driver board.

method.name: SetLaserMode
method.description: Sets the nLight Laser Mode. Board must have been initialized first.

param.name: LaserMode
param.description: Sets the laser mode.

method.name: GetRawDeviceState
method.description: Returns the raw device state as bit field. See nLight extension board documentation for details.

param.name: DeviceState
param.description: Device state bit field.

method.name: HasError
method.description: Checks, if the laser is in an error state.

param.name: ErrorState
param.description: Returns true if the laser is in an error state.

method.name: IsReady
method.description: Checks, if the laser is in a ready state.

param.name: ReadyState
param.description: Returns true if the laser has the ready state flag set.

method.name: ExternalControlIsReady
method.description: Checks, if the laser state can react to external control.

param.name: ExtControlReadyState
param.description: Returns true if the laser has the ExtControlReady state flag set.

method.name: IsEmission
method.description: Checks, if the laser is in emission state.

param.name: EmissionState
param.description: Returns true if the laser has the emission on flag set.

method.name: IsFirmwareReady
method.description: Checks, if the laser firmware is ready.

param.name: FirmwareReadyState
param.description: Returns true if the laser has the firmware ready flag set.

method.name: IsWaterFlow
method.description: Checks, if the laser water flow is on.

param.name: WaterFlowState
param.description: Returns true if the laser has the water flow flag set.

method.name: SetModeChangeDelays
method.description: Sets the mode change delays.

param.name: ModeChangeSignalDelayInMicroseconds
param.description: New mode change signal delay in microseconds. This is the length of the signal peak to the AFX laser. Default value is 10 microseconds.

param.name: ModeChangeApplyDelayInMicroseconds
param.description: New mode change apply delay in microseconds. This is the wait delay after the new mode has sent. Default value is 30000 microseconds.

method.name: GetModeChangeDelays
method.description: Returns the mode change delays.

param.name: ModeChangeSignalDelayInMicroseconds
param.description: Current mode change signal delay in microseconds. This is the length of the signal peak to the AFX laser. Default value is 10 microseconds.

param.name: ModeChangeApplyDelayInMicroseconds
param.description: Current mode change apply delay in microseconds. This is the wait delay after the new mode has sent. Default value is 30000 microseconds.

class.name: RaylaseIOCycle
class.description: Object to control a raylase list cycle.

method.name: GetCycleID
method.description: Returns the cycle ID as Integer.

param.name: CycleID
param.description: Cycle ID. Will not be 0.

method.name: AddSignalOut
method.description: Sets or clears a GPIO Output signal during the list cycle.

param.name: IOPort
param.description: IO Port to write out to. MUST be configured as output pin.

param.name: IOPin
param.description: IO Pin to write out to. MUST be configured as output pin.

param.name: HighNotLow
param.description: If true, sets the pin high. If false, sets the pin low.

method.name: AddWaitForSignal
method.description: Waits for an Input signal to be high or low during the list cycle.

param.name: IOPort
param.description: IO Port to read from. MUST be configured as input pin.

param.name: IOPin
param.description: IO Pin to read from. MUST be configured as input pin.

param.name: HighNotLow
param.description: If true, waits for the pin to be high. If false, waits for the pin to be low.

param.name: TimeoutInMicroseconds
param.description: Timeout in Microseconds.

method.name: AddDelay
method.description: Adds a delay to the list cycle.

param.name: DelayInMicroseconds
param.description: Delay in Microseconds.

method.name: IsConnected
method.description: Checks if the card is connected.

param.name: IsConnected
param.description: Flag if the card is disconnected.

method.name: ResetToSystemDefaults
method.description: Resets the card settings to system defaults.

method.name: EnableCommandLogging
method.description: Enables Command logging for the Raylase SDK interface.

method.name: DisableCommandLogging
method.description: Disables Command logging for the Raylase SDK interface.

method.name: RetrieveLatestLog
method.description: Retrieves the last Raylase SDK command log. Fails if Command logging was never enabled.

param.name: RaylaseLogInstance
param.description: Instance of connected card.

method.name: LaserOn
method.description: Turns the laser on.

method.name: GetNLightDriverBoard
method.description: Returns the NLight Driver Board Handler class.

param.name: DriverBoard
param.description: NLight Driver Board Instance

method.name: CreateIOCycle
method.description: Creates a new IO cycle with a certain ID. Fails if cycle ID is already existing..

param.name: CycleID
param.description: Cycle ID to use. MUST NOT be 0.

param.name: IOCycle
param.description: IO Cycle Instance

method.name: IOCycleExists
method.description: Returns if a IO cycle exists.

param.name: CycleID
param.description: Cycle ID to return.

param.name: IOCycleDoesExist
param.description: Returns true, if IO Cycle exists.

method.name: GetIOCycle
method.description: Returns a new cycle. Fails if cycle ID does not exist..

param.name: CycleID
param.description: Cycle ID to return.

param.name: IOCycle
param.description: IO Cycle Instance

method.name: RemoveIOCycle
method.description: Removes an IO Cycle of a certain ID. Does nothing if IO cycle does not exist..

param.name: CycleID
param.description: Cycle ID to remove.

method.name: LaserOff
method.description: Turns the laser off.

method.name: ArmLaser
method.description: Arms or disarms the laser.

param.name: ShallBeArmed
param.description: Shall the laser be armed or disarmed.

method.name: IsLaserArmed
method.description: Checks if the laser is armed.

param.name: LaserIsArmed
param.description: Flag if the laser is armed.

method.name: EnablePilot
method.description: Enables the pilot pointer.

param.name: ShallBeEnabled
param.description: Shall the pilot be enabled.

method.name: PilotIsEnabled
method.description: Checks if the pilot is enabled.

param.name: PilotIsEnabled
param.description: Flag if the pilot is enabled.

method.name: GetLaserStatus
method.description: Returns the laser status.

param.name: PilotIsEnabled
param.description: Flag if the pilot is enabled.

param.name: LaserIsArmed
param.description: Flag if the laser is armed.

param.name: LaserAlarm
param.description: Flag if the laser is in alarm state.

method.name: AssignLaserIndex
method.description: Assigns a laser index to the card.

param.name: LaserIndex
param.description: Laser index to assign. This will map to the laser indices given in the build file. 0 means no assignment.

method.name: GetAssignedLaserIndex
method.description: Returns the assigned laser index to the card. Default value is 0 (unassigned).

param.name: LaserIndex
param.description: Assigned laser index. This will map to the laser indices given in the build file. 0 means no assignment.

method.name: AddPartSuppression
method.description: Adds a part suppression. If Drawlayer encounters a part of a specific ID, it will suppress it depending on the suppression mode.

param.name: PartUUID
param.description: UUID of a part. Fails if not a valid UUID.

param.name: SuppressionMode
param.description: Part suppression mode. If DontSuppress is given, the part is removed from the list.

method.name: GetPartSuppressionMode
method.description: Returns the suppression. If Drawlayer encounters a part of a specific ID, it will suppress it depending on the suppression mode.

param.name: PartUUID
param.description: UUID of a part. Fails if not a valid UUID.

param.name: SuppressionMode
param.description: Part suppression mode.

method.name: ClearAllPartSuppressions
method.description: Clears all part suppressions that have been set before.

method.name: RemovePartSuppression
method.description: Removes a part suppression that was added before. Does nothing if part suppression does not exist.

param.name: PartUUID
param.description: UUID of a part

method.name: DrawLayerWithCallback
method.description: Draws a layer of a build stream with a progress callback. Blocks until the layer is drawn.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

param.name: CancellationCallback
param.description: A callback that is repeatedly checked for canceling the exposure.

param.name: UserData
param.description: pointer to arbitrary user data that is passed without modification to the callback.

method.name: DrawLayer
method.description: Draws a layer of a build stream with timeout. Blocks until the layer is drawn.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

param.name: ScanningTimeoutInMS
param.description: Maximum duration of the scanning process in milliseconds.

method.name: SetRotationalCoordinateTransform
method.description: Sets the rotational coordinate transform to use.

param.name: M11
param.description: Upper left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M12
param.description: Upper right field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M21
param.description: Lower left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M22
param.description: Lower right field of the transformation matrix.

method.name: GetRotationalCoordinateTransform
method.description: Returns the rotational coordinate transform in use. The default is the identity matrix.

param.name: M11
param.description: Upper left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M12
param.description: Upper right field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M21
param.description: Lower left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M22
param.description: Lower right field of the transformation matrix.

method.name: SetTranslationalCoordinateTransform
method.description: Sets the translational coordinate transform to use.

param.name: OffsetX
param.description: Translation in X in mm.

param.name: OffsetY
param.description: Translation in Y in mm.

method.name: GetTranslationalCoordinateTransform
method.description: Returns the translational coordinate transform in use. Default is 0/0

param.name: OffsetX
param.description: Translation in X in mm.

param.name: OffsetY
param.description: Translation in Y in mm.

class.name: Driver_Raylase
class.description: A LaserScanner Driver for a Raylase card.

method.name: SetToSimulationMode
method.description: Sets the driver in Simulation mode.

method.name: IsSimulationMode
method.description: Returns if the driver is in Simulation mode.

param.name: IsSimulationMode
param.description: Simulation mode is active.

method.name: SetCustomSDKResource
method.description: Sets the machine resource name of the SDK to load. MUST be called before LoadSDK or it has no effect.

param.name: ResourceName
param.description: Resource name of core machine package. Empty means standard naming applies.

method.name: LoadSDK
method.description: Initializes the Raylase SDK.

method.name: ConnectByIP
method.description: Connects to the Raylase Scanner Card. Fails if connection is not successful.

param.name: CardName
param.description: Name of scanner to be connected to. MUST not be in use.

param.name: CardIP
param.description: IP Address to connect to.

param.name: Port
param.description: Port to connect to.

param.name: MaxLaserPowerInWatts
param.description: Maximum laser power in Watts.

param.name: RaylaseCardInstance
param.description: Instance of connected card.

method.name: GetConnectedCard
method.description: Retrieves a connected card instance.

param.name: CardName
param.description: Name of scanner card to retrieve. MUST have been connected before.

param.name: RaylaseCardInstance
param.description: Instance of connected card.

param.name: CardName
param.description: Name of scanner card to retrieve.

param.name: CardExistsAndIsConnected
param.description: Returns true if card exists, false otherwise.

method.name: DisconnectCard
method.description: Disconnects and unregisters a card. Does nothing if card does not exist.

param.name: CardName
param.description: Name of scanner card to disconnect. Card will be removed from driver.

method.name: DrawLayerMultiLaserWithCallback
method.description: Draws a layer of a build stream. Blocks until the layer is drawn. The call will fail if the laser assignment of the cards is not unique.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

param.name: FailIfNonAssignedDataExists
param.description: If true, the call will fail in case a layer contains data that is not assigned to any defined scanner card.

param.name: CancellationCallback
param.description: A callback that is repeatedly checked for canceling the exposure.

param.name: UserData
param.description: pointer to arbitrary user data that is passed without modification to the callback.

method.name: DrawLayerMultiLaser
method.description: Draws a layer of a build stream. Blocks until the layer is drawn. The call will fail if the laser assignment of the cards is not unique.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

param.name: FailIfNonAssignedDataExists
param.description: If true, the call will fail in case a layer contains data that is not assigned to any defined scanner card.

param.name: ScanningTimeoutInMS
param.description: Maximum duration of the scanning process in milliseconds.
